a.xlink:title: Executes an MRS instruction (move data from CPSR/SPSR to an ARM register).
Executes an MSR instruction (move data to CPSR/SPSR from an ARM register).
Returns the type of the operation to be performed.
Returns the index of the Rd register (destination register).
Returns the type of the special register involved in the operation.
Returns a mask that protects different part of the special register.
Returns the index of the Rm register (source register; see Is_Immediate).
Calculates the second immediate operand of a given instruction.
Returns the value of the I bit.
Returns the value of the C bit (helper function).
Returns the value of the F bit (helper function).
Returns the value of the S bit (helper function).
Returns the value of the X bit (helper function).
Performs an ROR (rotate right extended) operation on the given integral value.
Tests whether a bit is set in the given integral variable.
